name: layout
title: Layout helpers and icons
description: Stack, row and grid helpers that space components with the spacing tokens, the stroke icon class, and small utilities (screen-reader-only text, muted text, numbers).
whenToUse: Spacing between components inside a card or page body. Use these before writing page CSS. Grids collapse to one column below 900px.

variants.description: Auto-fit grid, min column --tx-grid-min (220px); --2 and --3 fixed columns.
Visually hidden, read by screen readers.

a11y: Icons inside buttons are aria-hidden; the button carries the label.
